prompt_text: What is the best service to check if AI engines like ChatGPT recommend my small business?
ai_overview_text:
The best service to check if AI engines like ChatGPT recommend your small business depends on whether you want a dedicated AI visibility tracker or an all-in-one SEO and AI monitoring platform. Trustmary +1
Semrush AI Visibility Toolkit: Best for businesses already using traditional SEO, offering prompt monitoring, competitor tracking, and a 7-day free trial through Semrush ONE. YouTube +1
Ahrefs Brand Radar: Best for large-scale prompt tracking, built on a database of over 250 million real user prompts across multiple platforms. Trustmary
Peec AI: A popular dedicated European AI visibility tracker designed to monitor how brands appear in generative answers. Trustmary
LLMrefs: Best for tracking share of voice and exact citation sources across 11+ AI engines including ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, and Gemini. Trustmary
Profound: An enterprise-grade AI marketing platform that synthesizes brand data, tracks sentiment, and measures visibility scores across major answer engines. Profound +1
Budget-Friendly Options: Tools like Rankscale AI (starting around $20/mo) and Keyword.com AI Tracker offer daily prompt monitoring and AI readiness audits on a smaller budget. Trustmary
How to Test It Yourself for Free
Before paying for software, you can run a manual audit in about 10 minutes:
Open ChatGPT, Perplexity, or Google Gemini.
Ask natural, unbranded questions a customer would ask before buying (e.g., "Who is the best [your service] in [your city]?" or "What is the best [product type] for [specific problem]?").
See if your business name or website is cited in the single-answer output. Quora +4
